node.label: Left ventricular apical dyskinesis
node.definition: Dyskinesis is used to describe ventricular muscle segments that bulge outside the left ventricular cavity during systole, as opposed to contracting inwards with the rest of the segments.

evidence.snippet: Tako-Tsubo cardiomyopathy: Left ventricular apical dyskinesis (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
